description: How a PromptVariable is filled in: one line of text, several lines, or one value out of the list the template author declared in Options. The kind selects the INPUT the prompt library renders — a text box, a text area or a select — and nothing else: the parser substitutes the value as text in every kind and never evaluates it.

members.name: Text
members.description: A single line of text. The default.

members.name: Multiline
members.description: Several lines of text — a brief, an example, a body of source material.

members.name: Select
members.description: One value out of Options; a value outside the list is reported as a validation error rather than substituted silently.
